headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs with an 18-3 victory, led by Matt Chapman's 2-for-3 performance with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs. The Seattle Mariners fell to the Detroit Tigers 7-3, with Kerry Carpenter leading the Tigers' offense. The Philadelphia Phillies secured an 8-6 win over the Chicago White Sox, while the Boston Red Sox took down the New York Yankees 5-3.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the Colorado Rockies placing Tanner Gordon on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip impingement. The San Diego Padres also made several roster moves, including placing Jeremiah Estrada on the 15-day injured list and transferring Ramón Laureano to the 60-day injured list. Other teams affected by injuries include the Milwaukee Brewers, St. Louis Cardinals, Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees, and Kansas City Royals.

Several trades and roster movements occurred, including the Boston Red Sox acquiring LHP Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the Atlanta Braves acquired C Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays also made a trade, acquiring RHP Simeon Woods Richardson from the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs 18-3 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 18-3 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a strong team effort on both offense and defense. Matt Chapman led the Giants' charge at the plate, going 2-for-3 with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers. Kerry Carpenter led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 6-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the batting charge with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs. Brandon Eisert pitched a strong 1.0 inning, striking out 2 batters without allowing a run or walk.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Tanner Gordon on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Traded to Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox acquired LHP Joe La Sorsa in a trade. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded La Sorsa to the Red Sox on June 4, 2026.
